title: On Generalized Naive Bayes with Continuous Features
abstract: arXiv:2609.23819v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Generalized Naive Bayes (GNB) model was introduced for discrete and categorical random variables as an extension of classic Naive Bayes. We now accommodate the GNB framework to continuous explanatory variables. A central result of the paper is that structure learning of the GNB depends only on the pair copulas of the bi-variate marginals. We proved that the GNB structure can be assigned to the basis of a matroid, therefore we give greedy algorithms for finding the optimal GNB structure on the training data, in sense of minimizing Kullback-Leibler divergence. Three cases are considered: joint Gaussian distribution, then a more flexible model where we suppose the dependence structure to be described by a Gaussian copula with arbitrary marginals, and an even more flexible case where the joint continuous probability distribution is arbitrary, i.e. copula and marginal distributions are arbitrary. translated_title: 关于具有连续特征的广义朴素贝叶斯
translated_abstract: 广义朴素贝叶斯（GNB）模型最初是为离散和分类随机变量引入的，作为经典朴素贝叶斯的扩展。本文将GNB框架适配到连续解释变量。论文的一个核心结果是，GNB的结构学习仅依赖于双变量边缘分布的成对copula。我们证明了GNB结构可以对应于拟阵的基，因此我们给出了在训练数据上寻找最优GNB结构的贪心算法，其优化目标是最小化Kullback-Leibler散度。论文考虑了三种情况：联合高斯分布；一个更灵活的模型，其中假设依赖结构由具有任意边缘分布的高斯copula描述；以及一个更加灵活的情况，即联合连续概率分布完全任意，即copula和边缘分布均为任意。此外还提出了一种基于t……的模型简化方法（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文将广义朴素贝叶斯扩展到连续特征，证明其结构学习仅依赖双变量边缘分布的成对copula且该结构对应拟阵的基，从而提出通过最小化KL散度的贪心算法来寻找最优GNB结构。
en_tdlr: This paper extends Generalized Naive Bayes to continuous features, proves that its structure learning depends only on the pair copulas of bivariate marginals and that the GNB structure corresponds to a matroid basis, enabling greedy algorithms to find the optimal structure by minimizing Kullback-Leibler divergence.
